text_block_list.text: Passing by the gym, I noticed Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black bickering about something.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I really think you should stop, Dia-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm okay!
I'll definitely pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, perfect timing! Please,
help me stop Dia-chan!
I listened to what the two of them had to say. Apparently, the gym's treadmill features a 'Lunatic' difficulty setting that no one has ever cleared...

It seems an intensely curious Satono Diamond
is trying to become the very first person to succeed.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
With this many Umamusume around and nobody succeeding...
doesn't that mean it's incredibly dangerous!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, don't stop me.
You know how I am, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Deciding the outcome before you even try――
Where's the fun in that?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Because I'm definitely going to see this through to the end!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's give it a shot!
Let's wait and see how things go first.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, .
I'm so glad to have your support.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure it succeeds,
so please keep your eyes on me.

The moment I selected "Lunatic"――
the machine let out a roaring whir,
spinning at an imperceptible speed!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa...!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see... I'm getting fired up now!
Satono Diamond, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: N-No way, Dia-chaaan!! That's way too dangerous, I'm telling you~~!!

Somehow, I managed to calm down
an overly excited Satono Diamond...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Understood.
If the academy trainer
says so.

The moment I selected "Lunatic"――
the machine let out a roaring whir,
spinning at an imperceptible speed!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's way too dangerous, Dia-chan...!
At least prepare properly first!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, true...
Looks like we'd better train first!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll train on the exercise bike!
At maximum difficulty――'Catastrophe'!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: N-No, stop! Nobody's managed to clear that one yet either~~!!

Somehow, I managed to calm down
an overly excited Satono Diamond...
